The wheels are all put in motion when the person is alive but their brain is damaged enough that theres considered no likelihood of them returning to conciousness. When someone is in this position (on life support) we, as nurses call the organ donation network who then comes in and speaks with the family about organ donation. Once the family gives consent, the organ recovery surgery is preformed on the anatomically and legally still living patient. 

Someone isn't declared dead when their brain stops working but when their heart stops.
